claims: As of April 2026, Aubrey Plaza is expecting her first child with her partner, actor Christopher Abbott.

Aubrey Plaza and Jeff Baena met in 2011.
Aubrey Plaza and Jeff Baena married in May 2021.
Aubrey Plaza and Jeff Baena collaborated on Life After Beth.
Aubrey Plaza and Jeff Baena collaborated on The Little Hours.
Aubrey Plaza and Jeff Baena separated in September 2024.

Aubrey Plaza and Christopher Abbott worked together on the 2023 off-Broadway play Danny and the Deep Blue Sea.
Aubrey Plaza and Christopher Abbott are expecting a child in the fall of 2026.
